# Emad Moustafa (emadmstfa.com)

> Managing Director of WE Marketing and founder of MarketPilot. Designs growth, automation and MarTech systems for companies in Saudi Arabia and the UAE. WE Marketing (https://www.wemarketing.media) executes the campaigns; Emad designs the measurement, CRM and automation system around them.

## Key pages
- [About](https://emadmstfa.com/about): who Emad is, what he does and does not do.
- [How I work](https://emadmstfa.com/how-i-work): growth systems versus ad management, five-step method.
- [Insights](https://emadmstfa.com/insights): short articles on lead generation, AI and measurement.
- [WE Marketing](https://emadmstfa.com/agency): how the agency and the system relate.
- [Case studies](https://emadmstfa.com/): Saed Recruitment, Dr. Salwa Althaqafi, Wehej Real Estate.

## Notes on figures
Case-study figures come from platform and client reports for the stated period. A click, an enquiry, a qualified lead and a customer are different measures and are reported separately.
